extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: MINT-1T is the most extensive and diverse open-source Multimodal INTerleaved dataset to date, comprising one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images sourced from HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv documents. It is designed for training large multimodal models (LMMs) that can process interleaved sequences of images and text.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.publisher: University of Washington, Salesforce Research, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, University of California, Berkeley
extraction.citeAs: MINT-1T: Scaling Open-Source Multimodal Data by 10x: A Multimodal Dataset with One Trillion Tokens
extraction.rai:dataCollection: MINT-1T curates multimodal interleaved documents from diverse sources including HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv papers. The data collection process involves sourcing documents from CommonCrawl WARC/WAT files (HTML and PDF) and ArXiv LaTeX sources, followed by extensive filtering, deduplication, and safety checks. The dataset includes 922B HTML tokens, 93B PDF tokens, and 9B ArXiv tokens.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CommonCrawl WARC/WAT files (HTML and PDF documents) and ArXiv LaTeX sources
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: HTML: May 2017 to April 2024; PDF: February 2023 to April 2024; ArXiv: LaTeX sources from ArXiv repository
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Text quality filtering (language identification, NSFW removal, duplicate n-gram removal), image filtering (size, aspect ratio, NSFW detection), deduplication (paragraph, document, image), and safety filtering (PII anonymization, NSFW image removal).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be updated by the authors, with communication through the README in the Huggingface interface. Older versions will be maintained via Git history, and a form will be provided for opting data out of MINT-1T.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Email addresses and IP addresses are anonymized. The dataset may contain personally identifiable information from public web sources.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to bridge the gap between open- and closed-source multimodal models by providing a large-scale, diverse dataset. However, it may inadvertently include harmful or biased content despite filtering efforts.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may contain biases from its sources (e.g., HTML documents may be biased toward certain domains like humanities, while PDFs may be biased toward science and technology).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include potential link rot for external image URLs, the dataset's large size (300TB) making full hosting infeasible, and the presence of harmful or biased content despite filtering. PDF parsing may incorrectly extract reading order in some cases.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, and Fine-tuning of large multimodal models (LMMs). The dataset is intended for research purposes and should not be used for training models that ingest or generate personally identifying information or for military applications.
